title.narrative: Integrated Nutrition and Protection Response for Conflict -Affected Displaced and HC in the Kordofan

description.narrative: Escalating insecurity across the Kordofan States has displaced nearly 39,000 people across multiple localities, including around 2,000 individuals who fled Bara town and surrounding villages in early November due to intensified hostilities, relocating mainly to Khartoum and Sheikan locality in North Kordofan; this displacement has severely widened nutrition and protection gaps as families face inadequate shelter and limited access to food, safe water, sanitation, and health services, increasing risks of acute malnutrition, disease outbreaks, mental health distress, and gender-based violence (GBV), particularly among women, girls, children under five, pregnant and lactating women, and persons with disabilities, with recent MUAC screening in Sheikan locality showing a SAM rate of 5 percent and a GAM rate of 14 percent, alongside deteriorating food security affecting 362,165 people in IPC Phase 4. In response, the proposed project will deliver an integrated nutrition and protection intervention through mobile teams, static OTP services, and community centres, prioritizing early detection and treatment of acute malnutrition, support to overstretched health facilities, and strengthened GBV and specialized MHPSS services, addressing critical multi-sectoral needs that cannot be met through single-sector approaches, strengthening household coping mechanisms, reducing exposure to exploitation and negative survival strategies, and ultimately improving survival, safety, dignity, and resilience among displaced and host communities.
